resources.string: Sync Account to Car or Watch
This option requires you to be logged into a PodHopper account. Tap on the Profile page and login or create your account first.
Open PodHopper on your car or watch and it will show a pairing code. Enter that code below to sign that device into your PodHopper account.
Your device has been paired successfully.
Pairing failed. Check the code on your car or watch and try again.
